# LinkedIn Draft - 2026-08-22

A researcher bought an expired nameserver domain and gained control over multiple e164.arpa territories, later finding roughly 400,000 ENUM queries tied mostly to military-base calls.

Went through 40 links today. Here's what made the brief:

1. I accidentally logged hundreds of thousands of phone calls to military bases
   Concrete neglected-infrastructure failure with obvious security implications for telephony and routing systems.

2. OTel isn't going well (and I made a spreadsheet about it)
   This changes how to evaluate OTel adoption: by SDK health and maintainer depth, not by the brand alone.

3. How we made a text-to-speech model respond in sub-50 ms
   Useful if low-latency voice becomes relevant, especially for inference-system design rather than model choice.
